how-it-was-made.standfirst: Ko e ʻuhinga ʻoku ngaohi ʻaki ʻa e kalasi ʻa e tānaki fale fakamatala kotoa, mo e founga naʻe fai ʻe he ongo tangata ʻi Dresden.

segments.heading: Ko e palopalema naʻe fakalelei ʻe he kalasi
segments.text:
Ko ha falemaʻumaʻu ʻi he ngaahi taʻu 1880 naʻa ne lava ke tauhi meimei ha meʻa kotoa. Ko ha manupuna ʻe lava ke teuteuʻi. Ko ha fanga peetolo ʻe lava ke fakamaʻu. Ko ha ika ʻe lava ke ʻai ki ha ipu vai fakaʻai pea kei ʻilonga ai ʻo aʻu ki ha senituli.

Ka naʻe ʻikai lava ha ʻalu. Ko ha manumanu tahi sino molū, kapau ʻe ʻai ki ha vai fakatolonga, ʻe mole hono lanu ʻi ha ngaahi ʻaho siʻi, pea toki hoko atu ʻa hono foʻi. Ko e meʻa ʻoku toe ʻi he ipu ko ha meʻa hina mo teka ʻoku ʻikai akoʻi ha meʻa ki ha taha.

Ko ia naʻe mole ai ha vahe kātoa ʻo e puleʻanga monumanu mei he ngaahi falemaʻumaʻu, pea naʻe mole ia ʻi he potu kotoa, ʻi he taimi tofu pē naʻe kamata hoko ai ʻa e sioʻata ki he moʻui ʻi tahi ke fakaofo. Ko e ʻataʻatā ko ia naʻe fakafonu ʻe he Blaschka.

segments.heading: Naʻe ngāue ʻi he momoko, ʻikai ʻi he vela
segments.text:
Naʻe ngāue lahi ʻa Leopold mo Rudolf Blaschka ʻi he mafana māmalie, ʻo fakamolū ʻa e vaʻa mo e paipa ʻi he afi pea fakashape ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi meʻangāue nima kae ʻikai ke tā vela.

Ko e ngāue momoko ʻoku fakatōtōlō ange, pea ko e ʻuhinga ia ʻoku tolonga ai ʻa e kakato. Naʻa ne fakalelei ke nau toho ʻa e kalasi ki he filo, punou, mo langa ha sino koni ʻi he konga taki taha kae ʻikai ha mānava pē taha.

Naʻa nau langa ʻi he ngaahi vahe, pea ko e niʻihi ʻo e ngaahi vahe ko ia ʻoku manifinifi ange ʻi ha kili foʻi manu. Ko ia ia ʻe lava ai ha fakatātā ke ʻasi kae hā mai kei ʻa e ngaahi vahefonua ʻi hono loto, ko e meʻa pē taha naʻe ʻikai lava ha meʻa ʻe taha.

segments.heading: Founga ʻe tolu ke fakalahi ʻaki ʻa e lanu
segments.text:
ʻOku ʻikai ha founga pē taha ʻa Blaschka ki he lanu. Naʻa nau ngaue ʻaki ha meʻa ʻe tolu, fili ʻo fakatatau ki he ngāue.

Ko e niʻihi ʻo e ngaahi fakatātā kuo tā. Ko e niʻihi kuo pani, mo e lanu naʻe tutu ki loto ʻi hono ʻāʻanga. Pea ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he niʻihi ʻa e kalasi lanu tonu, ke ʻi loto ʻi he meʻa ʻa e lanu pea ʻikai lava ke mole.

ʻI he meʻa lahi, ʻoku ʻi mui ʻi he kalasi ʻasi ʻa e lanu kae ʻikai ʻi ʻolunga. Ko ia ʻoku kei hā pē ʻa e ngaahi fakatātā ni hangē ko e 1883, pea ko ia ʻoku siʻisiʻi ai e maumau mei hono ala ki ai.

segments.heading: ʻI he taimi naʻe ʻikai ko e kalasi ha tali
segments.text:
Naʻe ʻikai fakamamahi ʻa Blaschka koeʻuhi ko ʻenau meʻa ngāue. ʻI he potu ʻe fai lelei ange ai ha meʻa moʻoni, naʻa nau ngāueʻaki ha meʻa moʻoni.

Ko e ʻumu ʻo ha sisi ʻoku tauhi lelei tonu ia ia pē. ʻOku fefeka, ʻoku ʻikai popo, pea ko hono fa fakatātā ko e ngāue naʻe fakamoʻoni ki he konga pē taha naʻe ʻikai fiemaʻu ha tokoni. Ko ia ʻi he sisi Loma ʻi he tānaki ni, ko e sino ko e kalasi kae ko e ʻumu ko ha ʻumu moʻoni.

ʻI ha kelemutu ʻoku nofo ʻi ha paipa, naʻa nau ʻalu ange ʻo ʻufiʻufi ʻa e fakatātā ʻaki ʻa e ʻoneʻone, koeʻuhi ko e langa ʻe he manumanu ʻo hono paipa ʻaki ʻa e ʻoneʻone, pea ʻe ʻikai lau moʻoni ha faʻifaʻitaki kalasi.

segments.heading: Naʻe haʻu mei fē ʻa e totonu
segments.text:
ʻOku totonu ʻa e ngaahi fakatātā koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai ngāue ʻa Blaschka mei he fakakaukau pē. Naʻa nau ngāue mei he ngaahi tā fakatekinikale ʻa e kau mataotao siantisi, pea mei he ngaahi manumanu moʻui.

Ko Anton Dohrn, naʻa ne pule ki he potu vakai tahi ʻi Naples, naʻa ne ʻave ʻa e ngaahi taʻe-hokotuʻa moʻui ki Dresden. Ko e fehokotaki ko ia ʻoku fakalava ai ʻa e kakato ʻo e polokalama: ko ha kolo taʻe-tahi, ko ha sima ʻo e ngaahi monumanu Mediterranean moʻui, mo ha toko ua naʻa nau lava ke sio ki he taha pea toe ngaohi ia ʻi he kalasi.

ʻI he taʻu 1878 naʻa nau ʻoatu ʻa e fakatātā kehekehe ʻe 630. Naʻe hoko ʻa e lau ke laka hake ʻi he 700.

how-it-got-here.standfirst: Ko ha ʻoataʻi naʻe fai ʻi Dresden ʻi he 1882, mo e meʻa naʻe hoko ki ai hili ʻa hono aʻu mai.

segments.heading: Ko e meʻa naʻe fiemaʻu ʻe ha falemaʻumaʻu ʻi he 1880
segments.text:
Naʻe fiemaʻu ke fakatokolahi ʻa e falemaʻumaʻu ʻi he vaha ko eni. Ko e fakakaukau ko ha tokotaha ʻaʻahi kuo mamata ki he meʻa lahi fe pē ʻe lava ke ne toʻo hono fakamatala pē taha ki he māmani natula, ko ia ko e taumuʻa ko e fakakātoa.

Naʻe ngāue ʻa e ʻulu-taki fakakamata ʻo e Falemaʻumaʻu Canterbury, ko Julius von Haast, ʻi he mape totonu ko ia. Naʻa ne tānaki ʻa e meʻa fakalotofonua mo e muli, pea naʻa ne tui ko e meʻa muli mo e meʻa mamaʻo ʻe hiki ʻa e ongoongo mo e ʻaonga ʻo e Falemaʻumaʻu.

ʻO fakatatau ki he tokolahi naʻe hū ʻi he matapā, naʻe loto tatau ʻa Christchurch mo ia.

segments.heading: Ko e tangata naʻa ne ʻoataʻi ia
segments.text:
Naʻe ʻikai ko ha mataotao ʻilo-manumanu ʻa Haast. Ka ne feohi lahi ʻaupito mo ʻilo lahi. Naʻa ne fetohitohiaki mo Charles Darwin, mo e mataotao ʻakau ko Joseph Hooker, mo Ernst Haeckel, ʻa ia naʻe liliu ʻe heʻene ngaahi fakakaukau ki he fakatupulaki ʻa e mata ako.

ʻOku fakahā ʻe heʻene ngaahi tohi ha tokotaha naʻe muimui vāvāofi ki he ngaahi fakaikiiki ʻo e ʻilo-manumanu.

Ko ia ʻi heʻene kamata fakafonu ʻa e ʻataʻatā ʻo e feituʻu naʻe totonu ke ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi manumanu sino molū, naʻa ne ʻilo ʻa e meʻa naʻa ne fakatau mo hono ʻuhinga naʻe mahuʻinga ai.

segments.heading: Naʻe muʻomuʻa ʻa Otago
segments.text:
Naʻe ʻikai kamata ʻa e fakakaukau ʻi Christchurch. Ko Frederick Wollaston Hutton, ʻa ia naʻe hoko ko e tokotaha tauhi tānaki ʻi he Falemaʻumaʻu Univesiti ʻo Otago, kuo ʻoataʻi ʻe ia ʻa e ngaahi fakatātā Blaschka, pea naʻa nau fakahā ʻi he ava ʻo e falemaʻumaʻu ko ia ʻi he 1877.

Naʻe fakaueʻiʻi ʻa e fakatau ʻa Canterbury mei he meʻa ko ia.

Ko e ʻuluaki fakakaukau ʻa Haast ke tatau tonu ʻa e ʻoataʻi ʻa Hutton. Naʻe taʻofi ia ʻe Leopold Blaschka, ʻi ha ʻuhinga faingofua: naʻe ʻikai kei manatuʻi ʻe ia ʻa e meʻa naʻe ʻoataʻi ʻe Hutton.

Naʻe fuofua ʻohake ʻa e fakakaukau ʻi he 1879. Ka naʻe ʻikai fai ʻa e ʻoataʻi kae ʻoua kuo aʻu ki he 1882. Naʻe ʻikai aʻu mai ʻa e ngaahi fakatātā kae ʻoua kuo aʻu ki ʻOkatopa 1883.

Ko e meʻa ne ʻoataʻi ki ai ʻa Haast naʻe lahi ange ia ʻi he ʻa Otago pea kehekehe ʻaupito ʻi heʻene fakakātoa.

Pea ʻoku ʻi ai ha ʻataʻatā ʻi he lekooti ʻoku ʻikai lava ke tāpuni: ko e lisi ʻo e meʻa naʻa ne ʻoataʻi kuo ʻikai kei ʻi ai. Ko e meʻa ʻoku puke ʻe he Falemaʻumaʻu ko e kavenga naʻe ʻave, ʻikai ko e ʻoataʻi.

segments.heading: Naʻe taʻetotongi ʻa hono fā
segments.text:
ʻI ha tohi naʻe hoko mai, naʻe lave ʻa Leopold naʻa ne fetongi ha ngaahi fakatātā siʻi, pea kuo ne ʻohake taʻetotongi ha ngaahi kelemutu mo ha feoʻoli. Ko e ngaahi ngāue foʻou ia, ʻa ia naʻe teu ke hā ʻi he katalōgi hoko ʻa Blaschka.

Ko e meʻa ʻe fā ʻi he tānaki ni ko e ngaahi taumeʻa taʻetotongi ko ia. Ko e tolu ko e ngaahi ʻulu lalahi ʻo e ngaahi kelemutu ʻo e tahi. Ko hono fā ko ha polopo ʻe taha pē ʻo e feoʻoli molū.

Naʻe ko ha ngaahi sīpinga ia — ko ha tangata ngaohi ʻoku ʻave ki hano kasitoma ʻa ʻene fakatau foʻou.

segments.heading: Ko e meʻa naʻe hoko ki ai
segments.text:
Naʻe fakahā ʻa e ngaahi fakatātā ʻi he Loki Tekinolosia, ʻo fakaʻali ko e fine faiva ngāue ki he saienisi ʻikai ko e ʻilo-manumanu. Naʻe fakahā ʻe ha nusipepa ʻo Christchurch, ko e Press, ki heʻene kau lau ʻi ʻOkatopa 1883 naʻe hā ʻa e vaka Potukali ʻi hono lanu moʻoni pea meimei tatau mo e natula ke fakaʻāfeka.

Naʻe ʻikai tolonga fuoloa ʻa e taʻofi ko ia. ʻI he taʻu ʻe ua naʻe hā fakataha ai ʻa e ngaahi fakatātā mo e ngaahi sīpinga tauhi, pea ʻi he 1895 kuo veteki ʻa e Loki Tekinolosia mo tuku ʻa e ngaahi fakatātā ki loto he ngaahi fakaʻaliʻali ʻilo-manumanu, fakalelei ʻo fakatatau ki he meʻa naʻa nau fakaʻali ʻi ʻikai ki hono ngaohi.

ʻI he ʻaho ni, ʻoku fakahā ʻa e taha. ʻOku tauhi ʻa e toenga.

how-we-know.standfirst: Ko e potu ʻoku haʻu mei ai ʻa e ngaahi meʻa moʻoni ʻi he ngaahi peesi ni, mo e ngaahi feituʻu ʻoku fefetongiʻaki ai ʻa e ngaahi maʻuʻanga.

segments.heading: Founga ʻe ua ʻo e fasi lea
segments.text:
ʻOku ʻi ai ha founga tohi ʻe ua ʻi he ʻapiapi ni pea ʻoku ʻikai tatau honau pau.

Ko e taha ko e lekooti tonu ʻa e Falemaʻumaʻu ki he meʻa ʻoku ne puke: ha fika tauhi, ha kumi meʻa, ha fakamatala fakaesino naʻe tohi ʻe ha tokotaha fakalisi. Ko e fakamoʻoni ia.

Ko hono taha ko e fakamatalaʻi, naʻe tohi ke fakamatalaʻi ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ke sio ki ai. Ko e hongofulu mā ua ʻo e ngaahi fakamatala ʻoku toʻo mei he tohi kuo pulusi ʻe he Falemaʻumaʻu. Ko hono toe ko e ngaahi tohi ʻuluaki, tohi mei he ʻilo lautele ki he hisitolia natula, pea ʻoku fakahā pehē ʻe he taha kotoa ʻi he potu ʻoku ne hā ai.

segments.heading: ʻOku ʻikai fetokoni ha taha ki hono lau
segments.text:
ʻOku ʻikai felāveʻi ʻa e ngaahi fika kuo pulusi ki he tānaki ni, pea ko e taʻe felāveʻi ko ia ʻoku ʻikai ko ha halaia.

ʻOku lau ʻe he pepa fakatotolo ki he tānaki ʻa e 133, ʻo fakatefito ki he katalōgi ʻa Blaschka totonu ʻo e 1878. ʻOku ʻomi ʻe he ʻātakai fakamatala ʻa e Falemaʻumaʻu ʻa e 127 pe 128, ʻo fakatatau ki he founga fehuʻi. ʻOku fakamatalaʻi ʻe ha katalōgi tā ʻa e 122.

ʻOku nau lau meʻa kehekehe. ʻE lava ke kātaki ʻe ha fika tauhi pē taha ha kulupu ʻo e fakatātā ʻe hongofulu mā fā ʻi he laupepa pē taha, pea ʻe lava ke fakalisi ha fakatātā ko ha koni pē taha pe ngaahi koni lahi. ʻOku fakahā ʻe he ʻapiapi ni ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ʻi he lekooti ʻo e tānaki, ʻikai lomi ha kātoa.

segments.heading: Ko ha fakatātā ʻe taha ʻoku ʻikai ʻomi ʻe he ʻātakai fakamatala
segments.text:
ʻOku ʻi ai ha founga pau mo lava ke siviʻi ʻo e palopalema ko ia.

Fehuʻi ki he ʻātakai fakamatala ʻa e Falemaʻumaʻu ki he meʻa kotoa ʻi he tānaki Blaschka, pea te ke maʻu ʻa e lekooti ʻe 127. Fehuʻi kae ʻikai, ki he meʻa kotoa naʻe ngaohi ʻe Leopold Blaschka, pea te ke maʻu ʻa e 128.

Ko e kehekehe ko ha koni pē taha: ko ha founga tupulaki ʻo ha kelemutu tahi, tauhi 1884.137.110. ʻOku kakato hono lekooti tuku kehe pē ha vahe ʻe taha. Ko e vahe ʻoku fakahingoaʻi ai hono tānaki ʻoku ʻataʻatā, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai lava ha kumi ʻi he tānaki ko ia ke ne maʻu ia. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻi he ʻātakai fakamatala, ʻoku ʻi ai ʻi he tohi kuo pulusi, ka ʻoku ʻikai foki mai ʻi heʻene ʻeke.

segments.heading: Kuo hiki ʻa e ngaahi hingoa
segments.text:
Naʻe totonu ʻa e ngaahi hingoa fakasaienisi ʻi he ngaahi lekooti ni ʻi he taimi naʻe tohiʻi ai ʻi he 1880s. Ko honau lahi taha ʻoku ʻikai ko e ngaahi hingoa ʻoku tali he ʻaho ni. ʻI heʻene siviʻi ki he lisi fakavaha-lofia ʻoku ʻi ai he taimi ni, meimei ko e tolu vahe ʻe tolu ʻoku kei tuʻu.

ʻOku ʻikai fakaofo ia pea ʻikai ko ha faingataʻa ʻo e tānaki ni. ʻOku maʻu ʻe he tānaki Blaschka kotoa ʻi māmani ʻa e meʻa pē tatau, pea ʻoku ofi ʻa e fika kuo pulusi ki he kakato kotoa ki he ʻa Canterbury.

Ko ia ʻoku tuʻu ai ʻa e hingoa ʻo e katalōgi, koeʻuhi ko e meʻa ia ʻoku lau ai ʻa e lekooti. ʻI he potu ʻoku kehe ai ha hingoa fakaʻaho ni, ʻoku totonu ke ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻa e kehekehe ʻikai ki hono fetongi.

segments.heading: Ko e fika ʻoku ʻikai ʻi he ʻātakai fakamatala
segments.text:
Naʻe ʻoatu ʻe Blaschka ha fika ki he fakatātā kotoa ʻo ʻena katalōgi, pea ko e ngaahi fika ko ia ko e founga ia ʻoku fakafehoanaki ai ʻa e ngaahi tānaki Blaschka takatakai ʻi māmani.

ʻOku ʻikai ʻi he ʻātakai fakamatala ʻa e Falemaʻumaʻu ʻa e fika ko ia. Ko e meʻa ʻoku ʻi he ʻātakai fakamatala ko ha fika hokohoko ki loto, ʻoku hangē pē ka ʻoku ʻikai ko e meʻa tatau.

Ka ʻoku ʻi ai ʻi he lomi. ʻOku lisi ʻe he pepa fakatotolo ʻa e fika Blaschka takatakai mo e fika tauhi ʻi he ngaahi tohi valivali ʻo ʻene ngaahi peleti, pea ʻe lava ke fakatatau ai ʻa e 117 mei he 128 ʻo e ngaahi meʻa ʻi heni. Ko e tepile fakatatau naʻe tui ʻe he tokotaha kotoa ke fuofua langa ʻoku ʻi ai kimuʻa.

segments.heading: Ko e meʻa ʻoku ʻikai ʻi ai
segments.text:
Ko e niʻihi ʻo e meʻa ʻoku ʻikai ʻilo tofu pē.

Ko e lisi ʻo e meʻa naʻe ʻoataʻi ʻe Haast kuo mole. ʻOku ʻikai ʻi ai ha fakahā totonu ʻi he lekooti ʻe hiva, pea ko e vaka Potukali ko e taha ia. Ko ha meʻa ʻe taha ko ha konga maumau ʻo ha fakatātā ʻoku ʻikai fakaʻilongaʻi ʻe ha taha, pea ko e taha ʻoku fakahingoaʻi ʻaki pē ʻa e ongo lea Pilitania ʻi ha lēpeli motuʻa.

Kuo tohi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ko ia ʻi heni ko ha ngaahi ʻataʻatā ʻikai fakahomo, koeʻuhi ko ha tānaki ʻoku fakahā ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ʻikai ʻilo, ʻoku faingofua ange ke falala ki ai ki he meʻa ʻoku ne ʻilo.
